draft.title: The Hertzsprung-Russell diagram
card: A Hertzsprung-Russell (H-R) diagram plots stars by luminosity (total power output) against surface temperature. Temperature is drawn backwards: hot stars are on the left and cool stars are on the right.
a band running from hot, luminous stars at the upper left to cool, dim stars at the lower right. Most stars are in it, including the Sun.
cool but very luminous stars at the upper right, because they are very large with a huge surface area.
hot but dim stars at the lower left, because they are very small. A Sun-like star leaves the main sequence to become a giant, then ends as a white dwarf.
draft.remember: Position on the H-R diagram shows a star's temperature, luminosity and stage of life.

a.q: A star is cool at its surface but has very high luminosity. Where is it on the H-R diagram, and why is it so luminous?
opts: Upper right, because it is very large
Lower left, because it is very small
Upper right, because it is very hot
Lower left, because it is very large
a.why: Cool and luminous places a star at the upper right, with the giants. A cool surface gives off little light per unit area, so the star must have a huge surface area to be so luminous. Being very hot cannot be the reason, as its surface is cool.
a.clue: Cool stars give off little light for each square metre of surface.

b.q: Astronomers find a star with a very high surface temperature and very low luminosity. What is the best conclusion?
opts: It is a white dwarf, and it is very small
It is a giant, and it is very large
It is a main sequence star like the Sun
It is a white dwarf, and it is very large
b.why: Hot and dim places a star at the lower left, with the white dwarfs. A hot surface gives off a lot of light per unit area, so for the star to be dim overall it must be very small. Calling it a giant is tempting because both groups are unusual, but giants are cool and luminous.
b.clue: Hot surface but little total light means very little surface.

a.best: Upper right, because it is very large

b.best: It is a white dwarf, and it is very small
